claim_boundary: T11 is a prospective-for-its-own-outcomes exploratory atlas. It compares standards-defined multi-codepoint glyph systems, deterministic component forms and labels, matched incorrect labels, contexts, inter-block depths, the raw last decoder-block output, and the API-returned final hidden state across the same nine model/tokenizer cells used by T10. It cannot rescue or alter T10; establish emoji meaning, understanding, causality, mechanism, behavior, tokenizer independence, a scale law, an instruction-tuning effect, architecture or model generality, or independent replication; or inspect T11 reserve model outcomes before a later T12 endpoint and multiplicity family are frozen.

landing_pattern_registry.broad_bounded_null: Continuous matched margins and geometry show no coherent system-level pattern. Treat T8-T10 as a narrower single-codepoint alignment boundary.
landing_pattern_registry.compositional_candidate: Decomposed forms and component labels retain matched-control advantages across multiple systems and model cells. Freeze a narrow T12 reserve test before opening reserve outcomes.
landing_pattern_registry.lexicalization_candidate: Whole official names dominate component labels after their separate matched controls. Frame the next test around lexicalized sequence identity, not generic compositional semantics.
landing_pattern_registry.model_conditioned_regimes: Direction or context stability differs materially by frozen model cell. Retain an architecture-conditioned atlas and do not pool a model-general effect.
landing_pattern_registry.presentation_or_final_norm_candidate: Effects change with VS16/fusion or between raw last-block and returned final state. Localize the next experiment to that boundary without calling it a mechanism.
landing_pattern_registry.tokenizer_structural_account: Required token-length-matched incorrect-label controls erase the apparent advantage. Preserve the bounded negative and do not widen the panel.
